newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were stable in late trading on Monday as players remained on the sidelines because of a lack of fresh news, traders said.
"Prices remain stable in late trading as many traders are taking a wait-and-see attitude ahead of the Moslem fasting period starting next week," one trader said.
Indonesia has the largest Moslem population in the world.
The trader said olein was quoted at 1,455-60 rupiah/kg in Jakarta and at 1,445-50 rupiah/kg in Surabaya. No crude palm oil deals were heard.
Traders said the market is expected to stay slow on Tuesday because of an absence of fresh domestic and overseas factors.
